messages:
Priya R: Reminder: Altair VPC launch slated Wed 08:00 PST. Need final sign-off on network, IAM, KMS, audit. Owners: @Jordan L (network), @Samir D (infra), @Iris K (security).
Jordan L: TGW attachment is done. CIDR confirmed 10.16.0.0/16. Flow logs target s3://altair-flowlogs but current bucket policy blocks cross-account writes.
Samir D: I'll create the CMK with rotation enabled and attach alias "altair-cmk". Cross-account role ARN: arn:aws:iam::222233334444:role/Redwood-Altair-CrossRole. Need VPC endpoints for S3 and KMS before cutover.
Iris K: Drafted KMS key policy in ticket CS-4201; includes explicit principal for the cross-account role and our service principal. Recommending multi-region CloudTrail -> S3 with 90d lifecycle. Legal gave tentative OK for 90d; flagging for renewal notes.
Priya R: Action items: Jordan post route diff (EOD), Samir run smoke Tue 14:00 PST, Iris finalize policy and attach to CS-4201. ops-bot: created ticket CS-4201 and calendar event. Any blockers?
Jordan L: No blockers. I'll also scope a NAT egress restriction for the 2hr window to avoid large cost spikes.
Samir D: Smoke test plan: `curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" https://api.redwood.internal/health` from a host in the private subnet; then verify S3 put/get and KMS decrypt using cross-account role.
Iris K: Waiting on customer's IAM principal ARN to finalize policy; pinged PM for ARN.
Priya R: I'll confirm attendee list with Altair PM and collect a one-question feedback survey 24h after launch: "Was the launch well-communicated and executed?" :thumbsup:
